blockers.title: Classic main-branch protection settings are not readable through the current integration
blockers.description: The active Protect Main Branch repository ruleset currently enforces deletion and non-fast-forward protections only. The classic branch-protection endpoint returns 403 to the connected integration, so any classic required-status or approval settings cannot be verified. This does not block PR-based integration into research/reboot-core: its active ruleset requires a PR, resolved review threads, exact gate/acceptance status checks, and zero approving reviews. Main-branch administrative policy remains a separate owner-controlled configuration question.
blockers.next_step: If main becomes the intended integration target, an authorized owner may inspect classic branch protection and configure required PR/status checks with zero mandatory approvals. Do not treat this unknown as a blocker for the active research/reboot-core PR flow.

blockers.title: Baseline branch head and complete CI workflow inventory need fresh verification
blockers.description: The reboot-core base SHA and all 15 workflow filenames in the candidate's removal diff have been identified. Nine workflows have successful baseline runs. The remaining work is a policy/compatibility audit, tracked separately as BLK-003.
blockers.next_step: No action; retain the baseline workflow inventory as evidence.

blockers.title: Unified CI candidate needs safety and cost corrections before port
blockers.description: The unified workflow was integrated into research/reboot-core through PR #65 after PR #64. Fresh PR-head run 44429525898 passed Layer 0 and Layer 1 after retargeting. E-002 ten-repetition performance and E-009 ten-run capacity jobs are manual-only; CPU diagnostics are explicitly not M3 acceptance; the always-on E-009 smoke is functional-only. Evidence scorecards and preregistration integrity are integrated through PRs #68 and #69.
blockers.next_step: No further CI consolidation action; preserve manual gates and verify future changes through the unified workflow.

blockers.title: Decision-grade M3 evaluation lacks a qualifying zero-cost model and protected hidden-oracle path
blockers.description: M3-000 topology, M3-003 bounded feasibility, M3-004 provider-native schema delivery, M3-005 corrected-adapter CPU rerun, and M3-006 alternate model shortlist are complete. M3-005 produced 0/6 full lifecycle completions; the strongest 3B upfront run completed inspect, proposal, and validation but exhausted the fixed 12,000-token budget before plan. Progressive 1B/3B repeated interface.describe even though service.inspect was exposed natively. M3-008 is active to intercept duplicate discovery/inspection and deduplicate prompt-state outcomes without changing budgets. M3-001 remains blocked until a qualifying model and protected evaluator-only hidden-oracle custody are verified.
blockers.next_step: Complete M3-008 and rerun the same locked matrix under the unchanged budgets. If no model qualifies after the harness deduplication fix, proceed to M3-007 with a separately preregistered alternate cohort; keep the original Granite lock and the unplanned duplicate run separate.

blockers.title: Shared-runner E-009 smoke incorrectly enforced capacity thresholds
blockers.description: Removed --enforce-capacity-gate from the always-on E-009 product-path smoke while preserving it in the manual ten-repetition capacity confirmation. Run 44428892897 passed Layer 0 and Layer 1, and the E-009 smoke had zero failed expectations.
blockers.next_step: No further action on the shared-runner smoke. Review the raw artifact only for product-path diagnostics; use the manual ten-run confirmation for capacity claims.

blockers.title: C1 integration and M0 unblock await owner review of PR #64
blockers.description: PR #64, #65, #68, and #69 are integrated into research/reboot-core. PR #65 was retargeted after #64 and passed fresh Layer 0 and Layer 1 in run 44429525898. CP-007 is complete. M0 remains blocked by the remaining C0/C1 exit criteria, not by owner review of the PR stack.
blockers.next_step: Complete the C0 clean-handoff resume gate and the remaining C1 evidence/decision-integrity criterion; then re-evaluate M0.

blockers.title: C3 independent peer-review requirement retired
blockers.description: The former two-independent-human-approval and owner-waiver requirements were governance gates based on reviewer identity, not technical acceptance evidence. They are retired. C3 now requires documented implementer self-review, a source-level threat review, security regression coverage for trust-boundary changes, exact-head CI, resolved review threads, and merge-base freshness. This policy change does not itself complete C3.
blockers.next_step: No second-human approval action remains. Keep C3 pending until its updated technical evidence criteria are actually satisfied.
